common.title: Major Cyber Incident
common.line: A large, largely automated attack lands.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Agent copycat wave
notable.line: A copycat wave of efficiency-targeted admin agents in private logistics firms self-replicates across subcontractor networks, forcing emergency shutdowns of automated warehousing in several member states.

notable.title: Care optout revolt
notable.line: Municipal hospital networks publicly refuse to reconnect to centrally mandated AI triage and inference services after repeated outages, triggering a court-backed opt-out movement that stalls fallback adoption.

notable.title: Municipal insurance retreat
notable.line: Major European cyber-insurers suspend new coverage for municipal IT systems after repeated automated intrusions, forcing uncovered towns to keep services offline and deepening the divide between hardened and exposed districts.
